rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing professional education in veterinary medicine meeting Board criteria; max 15 h non-interactive correspondence (interactive distance education is not correspondence)
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required before the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random Department audits; keep certificates at least 3 years.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal. Of the 30 hours, at least 1 hour must be on dispensing legend drugs and at least 2 hours on the laws and rules governing veterinary practice (Chapters 455 and 474, F.S., and rule Division 61G18). Max 15 h non-interactive correspondence; max 5 h each for alternative medicine, practice management, wellness. 5 h laws/rules credit once per biennium for a full Board disciplinary meeting.
rules.legal_basis: Fla. Admin. Code r. 61G18-16.002; Fla. Stat. §474.211
rules.rule_quote: Every biennium licensed veterinarians are required to obtain 30 hours of continuing education in the area of Veterinary Medicine.
